DISPLAY_MODE_DOC: Choose whether to run purely as a standalone Clock Screensaver or show the Full Player Menu with idle screensaver.
ENABLE_SCREENSAVER_DOC: Automatically display the clock screensaver overlay when the screen is idle in Full Menu mode.
IDLE_TIMEOUT_DOC: Seconds of inactivity before the clock screensaver overlay activates in Full Menu mode.
ACTIVE_CLOCK_DOC: Choose which clock HTML file from submodule/clocks to display.
